name: audio-foley
author: VORTEX-OS
description: Generate foley sound effects (footsteps, fabric, impacts) from natural-language prompts. Wraps MiniMax-Music.

duration_s.description: Length of the output in seconds

file.description: Absolute path to the generated audio file

primary.name: mcode-tools
primary.notes: Cloud-hosted MiniMax foley / SFX generation via mcode-tools CLI. (Will fail silently if the connector is not registered -- falls through to the ffmpeg-tone path.)

fallbacks.name: local-ffmpeg-tone
fallbacks.notes: ffmpeg sine-wave tone with a frequency derived deterministically from the prompt hash (200-1000 Hz range). Same prompt = same tone across runs, so cross-take consistency is preserved.
